messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Mi rigardis supren kaj vidis ĝiajn ŝultrojn vestitaj jam per la radioj de la planedo kiu gvidas homojn rekte laŭ ĉiu vojo.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | guardai | “looked upward” (perceptual verb) | **rigardis** | looked | OK | | in | preposition of direction “in” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | alto | “high” (spatial direction) | **supren** | upward / high | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **kaj** | and | OK | | vidi | “saw” (perceptual verb) | **vidis** | saw | OK | | le | definite article (fem. pl. acc.) “the” | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sue | possessive adjective “its” | **ĝiajn** | its (plural accusative) | OK | | spalle | noun “shoulders” (acc.) | **ŝultrojn** | shoulders | OK | | vestite | past participle “clothed” | **vestitaj** | clothed | OK | | già | adverb “already” | **jam** | already | OK | | de' | preposition “of” (di + i) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | raggi | noun “rays” (pl.) | **radioj** | rays | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” (di + il) | **de la** | of the | OK | | pianeta | noun “planet” | **planedo** | planet | OK | | che | relative pronoun “that” | **kiu** | that / who | OK | | mena | verb “leads” | **gvidas** | leads | OK | | dritto | adverb “straight / aright” | **rekte** | straight | OK | | altrui | noun “people” (indirect object) | **homojn** | people | OK | | per | preposition “along” | **laŭ** | along / according to | OK | | ogne | adjective “every” | **ĉiu** | every | OK | | calle | noun “path” (sing.) | **vojo** | path | OK |
### Items to Note - **UNNECESSARY**: `in`, `le`, `de'` – Italian articles/prepositions that Esperanto does not require in this construction. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
